title: Journey to JPEG XL: open-source experiments shaped the future of image coding
summary: This blog post from Google's Open Source Blog chronicles the development journey of JPEG XL, highlighting how open-source experiments and community collaboration shaped the modern image codec that serves as a successor to traditional JPEG. The article details Google's involvement in the standardization process and how open-source contributions drove innovation in image compression technology.
problem_solved: It documents how collaborative open-source development accelerated the creation of JPEG XL, a next-generation image format offering superior compression efficiency and quality compared to legacy formats.
why_valuable: This article provides valuable insights into how open-source community contributions can influence and shape industry standards for fundamental web technologies like image coding.
